question: According to the Law of Demand, if the price increases, the demand will _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Decrease.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• According to the law of demand, if price increases the **quantity demanded will decrease.**
 
• The **Law of Demand** states that if all other factors are equal, the demand for a good is inversely proportional to the price of the good.
 
• Law of Demand is given by **Adam Smith 1776.**
 
• Determinates of Demand

 
• Price of the good
 
• Level of desire for the product
 
• The income of the buyer
 
• Price of related goods i.e substitute goods and complementary goods.
 
• Future expectations in respect of price and income.
